name: Load WebViewer App ( {webViewer; url  } )
purpose: Loads a URL into a named web viewer and waits until the page has loaded: resets the viewer, sets the URL, then checks the viewer content every half second (up to about 5 seconds) for a closing html tag. Returns an error JSON on cancel or time-out and {errorCode:0} on success.
external:
Set Web Viewer (step 33, reset the viewer in $webViewer)
Set Web Viewer (step 35, go to $url)
open_question: Part of the FM WebViewer Bridge module used by the chart previews. The flag names mix spellings ($$WebVeiwer.Loading is set; $$WebViewer.LoadApp.Cancel is read), so the cancel flag and the loading flag are different variables. Time-out is 10 passes of 0.5 s.
